name: new_glenn fairing
note: Launch vehicle render model (tools/make_rocket_models.py), new_glenn: fairing. Body frame: +Z toward the nose, origin at the aft end; engine bells below it. Stage split, strake and fin sizes estimated from photographs. One fairing half (the other is it turned 180 deg about +Z), in the stage's frame: separated, it falls away tumbling.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: +Z along the thrust axis (the sim passes it as 'velocity'), -Y (the ship's heat shield) down
sources.source: A rocket flies along its thrust axis; a gravity turn and an entry fly belly down.

sources.value: diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes (ogives, flaps, tapers) estimated from photographs
sources.source: Blue Origin New Glenn page / Payload User's Guide: 98 m tall, 7 m across, fairing 7 m x 21.9 m | Wikipedia 'New Glenn': 7 BE-4 on GS1, 2 BE-3U on GS2, six landing legs, four forward fins, aft strakes

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail)
sources.source: Liveries from photographs; reflectance from the presets.
